verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no version pinning, release tags, lockfile, or update-control mechanism for the skill. Installation is either through the host's plugin marketplace or by manually copying the skill folder into a project directory. A copied folder would not update silently, but that is a user-side workaround and host-platform behavior, not a capability the skill itself provides.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
